verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents isolated cloud sandboxes provisioned programmatically. It ships official Go, Python and TypeScript SDKs plus a raw HTTP API authenticated with a team API key. New sandboxes can be claimed from templates or snapshots. However, no evidence shows that a single call creates a sandbox, and no startup-latency figures support the 'live in seconds' claim. Missing for 10: a documented one-call create example, cold-start/provisioning time evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of speed.
